verdict.rationale: Productboard markets a built-in agent that handles information synthesis from idea to delivery-ready (docs-22). Its in-product assistant, Spark, can take delegated actions through natural language, such as creating and updating Linear issues, acting in Slack, and querying Amplitude and Notion (intdir-5 to intdir-8). The MCP server is an external-agent pathway and is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on Spark's task scope and controls, delegation of tasks on native Productboard data inside the app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
